$comment: Presentation-only extension. For an eligible measured sample, display time is local monotonic time + offsetMs + max(0, rttMs/2 - rewindMs). Predict only current snapshot targets, at most500ms beyond serverTimeMs, never at or beyond their expiresAt. Server still selects receipt-minus-bounded-rewind independently. No target seed or future spawn schedule is public.

calibration.$comment: Only in admitted shooter's duck.clock_reply ACK. Offset and RTT come from the same minimum-RTT recent sample that authoritative rewind uses. Rewind=min(150,floor(RTT/2)), expiresAt=measuredAt+15000. Reset on epoch/disconnect/departure/end. RTT includes queues and client processing; symmetry remains an estimate.
